_about: Public-domain Alexander Macwhorter (1734-1807), Presbyterian minister of Newark, New Jersey, and army chaplain in the Revolution, for the Word Hoard: The Blessedness of the Liberal, and his two-volume Series of Sermons upon the Most Important Principles of our Holy Religion. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 106 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

macwhorter-blessedness-liberal: The blessedness of the liberal : a sermon preached in the Middle Dutch Church, before the New-York Missionary Society, at their first Institution, November 1, 1796 (New-York : Printed by T. and J. Swords ..., 1796)
macwhorter-sermons-1: A series of sermons, upon the most important principles of our holy religion, vol. 1 (Newark, Printed by Pennington & Gould, for the author, 1803)
macwhorter-sermons-2: Sermons on the most important principles of our holy religion, vol. 2 (Newark : Printed by Pennington & Gould, 1803)

_excluded.macwhorter-yahveh: Yahveh Christ (1857), by a later Alexander MacWhorter
